BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The attacker must be able to change files on the same host.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker must win the timing window between the check and the use.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker needs a low-privileged local account.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the vulnerable process.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The process can be made to read a file chosen by the attacker.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The process can be made to write or replace a file chosen by the attacker.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by static analysis of the vulnerable code pattern.
